rule: Work on one active feature. Change acceptance text only when the product requirement changes, not to fit an incomplete implementation.

features.title: Repository bootstrap, source pinning, licensing, and flavor manifest
acceptance: A clean checkout reproduces the host/Android bootstrap build
Pinned upstream commits and license/distribution status are recorded
Proprietary client/data paths are excluded from source control and release artifacts
features.notes: Bootstrap complete on this machine: monorepo layout, three pinned git submodules, license/redistribution manifest, offline flavor contract, proprietary-data exclusion (tested). python3 Store-stub bypassed; ANDROID_SDK_ROOT set.
evidence: NDK r30 arm64-v8a native build smoke (API 26) -> valid aarch64 .so
Android Compose debug APK smoke build -> valid 8.7 MB APK (minSdk26/targetSdk35)

features.title: Android Compose shell, supervisor state model, storage roots, and foreground service
acceptance: APK starts on the reference device
Supervisor states and foreground notification are visible
Internal mutable storage and import/export roots are separated
features.notes: Kotlin/Compose shell with typed supervisor state machine, dataSync foreground service (notification reflects state + Save & Exit), separated storage roots, DataStore settings, structured logging, Home/Settings/Diagnostics nav. Startup sequence is simulated; O03-O05 swaps in the real native bring-up.
evidence: ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL (valid 17 MB APK, minSdk26/targetSdk35, no INTERNET perm)
Lifecycle on device: Idle->Starting->Running->Saving->Idle verified via UI tree
dumpsys notification: FOREGROUND_SERVICE, title='Pocket Realm', text='Running | tap to play', action='Save & Exit'
adb run-as: files/realm/{db,generations}+content+runtime internal; only exports on external

features.title: Portable Android ARM64 CMaNGOS and Playerbots build
acceptance: Release ARM64 libraries/binaries build with the pinned NDK
Build is compatible with the device page size and does not assume one core type
Host/unit smoke tests pass

features.title: Embeddable realm lifecycle facade
acceptance: Realm can create/start/health/save/stop/destroy twice in one process
No process exit or console-only control is required
C ABI ownership and error behavior are tested

features.title: Loopback auth/world endpoints and Android realm supervision
acceptance: Supervisor starts and stops native realm
Health waits for database/auth/world readiness
No game listener is reachable from a non-loopback interface

features.title: Reference database installation and behavioral baseline
acceptance: Pinned schemas install and migrate deterministically
A reference character/item/quest/mail/auction fixture passes
Database lifecycle is controlled by the realm supervisor

features.title: SQLite schema, adapter, and differential parity
acceptance: Core persistence fixtures match reference behavior
Transactions and prepared statements pass retry/concurrency tests
Exact SQLite/WAL version is recorded and qualified

features.title: Dirty-generation marker and abrupt-stop recovery
acceptance: Kills at each lifecycle transition recover deterministically
Item/gold/claim invariants remain true
UI never labels an unverified state clean

features.title: Verified backup, restore, rollback generations, and storage-pressure behavior
acceptance: At least two verified generations are retained
Backup health includes disposable restore and realm start
Full/removed storage produces an actionable safe state

features.title: Supported-client import, validation, and data-pack extraction/import
acceptance: Supported build/locale is identified by manifest/hash
Malicious/invalid archives and unsupported clients are rejected safely
A verified content generation starts the realm

features.title: Client runtime provider interface and Box64/Wine WoW64 candidate
acceptance: Provider components and prefix/cache generation are isolated and pinned
Client reaches world through loopback and exits cleanly
Cold/warm, zoning, lifecycle, and crash scenarios are recorded

features.title: FEX laboratory provider
acceptance: FEX uses an isolated rootfs/prefix/cache
Non-root Android, Wine, graphics, audio/input, lifecycle, and page-size results are explicit
Automatic selection cannot choose an unqualified FEX tuple
Advanced settings can select an isolated FEX tuple and clearly show laboratory status

features.title: DXVK/WineD3D renderer tuples, shader caches, and frame-pacing profiles
acceptance: DXVK and WineD3D are separately selectable and diagnosed
30/40/60 FPS profiles are measured on 120 Hz output
Cache invalidation and fallback never corrupt the prefix or hide effective renderer

features.title: Native Retroid controller bridge, calibration, cursor, vibration, and hot-plug
acceptance: All first-run and gameplay-critical flows are controller accessible
Dead zones/mappings survive restart and controller reconnect
No Accessibility-service key injector is required

features.title: PocketCore/PocketController/PocketBots addon suite and curated profiles
acceptance: Required addons load without Lua errors on supported builds
Combat/cursor/chat/bot modes work with controller
Safe Mode can recover from an optional addon failure

features.title: Resumable first-run wizard and automatic local account provisioning
acceptance: Every wizard stage resumes after process death
Random local credentials are protected and not shown as reusable plaintext
A new user reaches Ready without console/SQL/manual server commands

features.title: Polished home, recovery, settings, and bounded Advanced screens
acceptance: Primary flow is Start/Continue/Save & Exit/Recovery
Advanced changes are generation-managed and rollbackable
Effective runtime/renderer/bot settings are visible in diagnostics

features.title: PvE bot population director, human-first scarcity, and bounded market helper
acceptance: Protected/resident/elastic/latent classes are measurable
Visible population changes naturally and scarce objectives prioritize the human
Market helper budgets and item provenance prevent unrestricted inflation/fabrication

features.title: Graphics CVar registry and reversible visual-overlay manager
acceptance: Only verified 1.12 settings are applied
Optional packs are scanned, isolated, benchmarked, and reversible
Golden scenes catch missing/broken models and severe visual regressions

features.title: Unified performance, battery, thermal, and world-quality controller
acceptance: Degradation order protects correctness and visible/party/resident bots
Controller responds to CPU/GPU/server/thermal bottlenecks without oscillation
Raw power/thermal/frame/server/world-quality metrics are retained

features.title: Signed updates, rollback, diagnostics, privacy, and support bundle
acceptance: Updates stage and smoke-test a candidate generation
Previous accepted generation remains recoverable
Support bundle is redacted and includes exact hashes/effective settings

features.title: Retroid Pocket 6 physical qualification and offline release acceptance
acceptance: Complete first-run-to-play and controller-only flows pass
Save/kill/power-loss/backup/restore/runtime/addon rollback campaigns pass
Two-hour and eight-hour sustained performance, battery, thermal, memory, and world-quality evidence passes release targets

features.title: Permanent offline/connected realm data and UI separation
acceptance: Storage, IDs, keys, accounts, characters, backups, and services are separate
Offline data cannot be mounted or merged as connected progress
Optional genesis copy creates a new realm with explicit one-way semantics

features.title: Authenticated P2P QUIC transport with direct, relay, and privacy modes
acceptance: Two Android devices connect on LAN, Internet/NAT, and relay paths
Route/IP exposure is visible
Streams, queues, retries, reconnects, and snapshot bandwidth are bounded

features.title: Private invitations and optional Android-bound community membership
acceptance: Private invite/revoke flow works without pretending to prove host honesty
Strict role certificate binds app/device key, realm, mesh identity, policy, role, expiry, and revocation
Unsupported firmware is given an honest lower trust tier

features.title: Rust Realm Kernel API, global IDs, names, sessions, and authority leases
acceptance: Typed bounded commands replace remote SQL/admin console
Global ID/name/session/lease conflicts resolve canonically
Stale or expired leases/epochs are rejected

features.title: Canonical item, gold, loot, trade, mail, auction, and progression transactions
acceptance: Idempotent retry returns one stable outcome
Ownership/balance/claim invariants hold under disconnect and replay
No divergent writable branch can settle shared value

features.title: Signed journal, checkpoints, replicas, state roots, epochs, and fencing
acceptance: Checkpoint restore reproduces the committed state root
Old authority output/writes are rejected after promotion
Accepted crash fault loses no committed durable event

features.title: Explicit realm clocks, certified dormancy, and first-peer recovery
acceptance: All peers offline stops simulation and produces a canonical dormant record
Return selects the highest valid history and applies bounded catch-up once
Equal-certification root conflict stops in fork recovery rather than merging

features.title: Translated-client-aware behavioral and invariant anti-cheat
acceptance: Gameplay/economy/protocol invariants remain enforced under Box64/FEX/Wine
Unreliable memory/renderer/timing checks are disabled or evidence-only, not global anti-cheat
Observe/correct/kick policy is calibrated with false-positive evidence

features.title: Human-responsive connected bot density and PvE fairness
acceptance: Elastic bots yield gradually to unique active humans while resident floors remain
Alts/zone hopping cannot rapidly manipulate density
Protected party/raid bots and human scarcity priority remain correct

features.title: Legacy Session Anchor and backend session transport abstraction
acceptance: Client remains on one local TCP/header-crypt session while backend route changes
Anchor owns sequencing/bounds but no gameplay authority
Backend no longer requires direct WorldSocket ownership

features.title: Versioned migration capsules, dirty tracking, pre-copy, and planned handoff
acceptance: No raw pointer/process image/socket/database connection is serialized
Baseline+deltas converge to equal semantic state roots
Epoch commit, atomic route switch, activation, and source fence work without relog

features.title: Hot-standby replication and crash failover
acceptance: Standby applies authoritative deltas rather than simulating a second world
Qualified crash promotes through a higher epoch and replays input once
No committed durable loss or duplicate outcome; client avoids character selection

features.title: Whole-continent and instance authority, transfers, groups, bots, and transports
acceptance: Ordinary zones/cities remain within one authority
Continent/dungeon/raid transfers use normal loading screen and atomic state transfer
Groups, party bots, lockouts, boats/zeppelins, and visibility remain coherent

features.title: Multi-device connected qualification and release acceptance
acceptance: LAN/NAT/relay/partition/stale/clock/crash/dormancy/restore/migration tests pass
One canonical economy and explicit degraded behavior hold
Physical-device latency, power, thermal, storage, bandwidth, anti-cheat, privacy, and bot-quality targets are met
